create_order trusts client-sent quantity but recomputes price/name from DB - good. Consider also enforcing max quantity per line.
JWT_SECRET present in backend/.env - OK; ensure not committed to VCS.
Single 393-line server.py is acceptable now but split routers/models if growth continues.
